en.body: Cambridge Hospital Dhahran collaborated with Al-Dhahran Municipality on a public Stuttering Awareness Day event at Dhahran Mall. Speech and language therapists led workshops, demonstrations and interactive activities, offering practical guidance to families while promoting early intervention and greater understanding of communication disorders.
